title: Korea official foreign-exchange reserves

locate.en: On ECOS (ecos.bok.or.kr), open 통계검색 (Statistics search) and type the table name “외환보유액” or its code 732Y001 in the search box, or follow the statistics list 3. 환율/통관수출입/외환보유액 > 3.5. 외환보유액. In the table, select 계정항목: 합계. Set the cycle (주기) to monthly, choose the period, and click 조회 (Search).
